otherFindings.summary: H8: Action Text content-attachment model and edit-time sanitization change can alter or drop stored or imported HTML (high).
H9: Blob analysis now touches owning records, which can move notes into later digests and invalidate caches (high).
H10: The local secret file rename and key precedence could change signing keys, invalidating sessions and signed attachment links (high, conditional).
M2: The built-in Sidekiq adapter used with Sidekiq 6.5 is deprecated for removal in Rails 8.2 (medium).
M3: The resolved json 3.1 is incompatible with Rails 8.1.0's ActiveSupport::JSON.decode positional options and the column coder's escape option, a runtime blocker (medium).
M4: Trix moves into the action_text-trix gem while the app still loads vendored Trix 1.3.5, giving a mixed old editor with new styles and integration (medium).
Conditional on adopting 7.1 defaults: the HTML5 sanitizer changes how the allowlist and imported rich text are handled (high).
Conditional on adopting 7.1 defaults: the cache format and message serializer/metadata change creates old/new reader compatibility and rollback risk (high).

H9: Blob analysis now touches the owning records, which can move notes into later digests' updated-today window (high).
H10: The local secret file rename and key precedence can change local signing keys, invalidating sessions and signed attachment references (high, conditional).
M2: The built-in Sidekiq adapter used with Sidekiq 6.5 is deprecated and will be removed in Rails 8.2 (medium).
M3: The resolved json 3.1 is incompatible with Rails 8.1.0's JSON.parse calls and the JSON column coder, which blocks JSON decoding at runtime (medium).
M4: Trix is extracted into the action_text-trix gem while the app keeps its vendored Trix 1.3.5 script, mixing an old editor with new integration code and styles (medium).
Adopting the 7.1 HTML5 sanitizer default changes how imported and rich-text HTML is sanitized (high, conditional).
Adopting the 7.1 cache and message format defaults affects old/new compatibility of export fragments and signed blob links (high, conditional).
